task_message:
Case M30: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 180x180x160 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. I segmented the myxoid soft-tissue tumor in this T2-weighted MRI:

- **Finding:** a large, markedly T2-hyperintense, lobulated soft-tissue mass (myxoid tumor) in the limb, spanning ~52×40×53 mm with a diagonal long axis.
- **Workflow:** located it on axial/coronal/sagittal sheets, seeded it with a single positive point → initial mask (46.7 mL), refined the boundary, added a positive prompt to include the slightly less intense posteromedial lobe at the tapered end, and verified the outline against the lesion edge at numerous slices through the mid-portion and both ends in all three planes.
- **Final result:** single connected component, 48.9 mL, with the green outline following the lesion boundary in all three planes and no lesion tissue visible in the past-the-mask review panels. Confidence: medium (minor partial-volume uncertainty at the tapered upper end).
